title: Success is preserved under more fuel
summary: If a program halts within n CEK steps, it halts in the same final state for any fuel m >= n. Failure is not preserved: running out of fuel ends in the same error state as a genuine failure.

title: Run outcomes are well defined
summary: A successful run never ends in the error state, and every run with zero fuel is unsuccessful.

title: Valid transactions spend an input and pay a positive fee
summary: Every transaction accepted by the V3 model has at least one input and a strictly positive fee.

title: Non-ada tokens are conserved when nothing is minted
summary: For every transaction accepted by the V3 model with an empty mint, the non-ada tokens in the inputs equal those in the outputs.

title: In the V3 model, ada in equals ada out plus fee
summary: For every transaction accepted by the V3 model, input ada equals output ada plus the fee, so ada strictly decreases. This is the model's rule, not the chain's: on chain, withdrawals, refunds, deposits and donations also move ada. The model's rule matches the chain's for transactions with none of these.

title: Valid transactions never mint or burn ada
summary: For every transaction accepted by the V3 model, the mint field holds no ada: its lovelace amount is zero.
